Time in UTC when this key's configuration was last changed. For the same
 key, later is fresher, equal is an idempotent replay, and earlier is stale.
 Equal timestamps with different configuration indicate an invariant failure.
 This is independent of last_used_at, which tracks authentication activity.
updatedAt.title: updated_at

Owner (root account) primary Smart Account address, when available. Allows
 clients to display a stable identity even when no username is set.
ownerRootSmartAccountAddress.title: owner_root_smart_account_address

ownerUsername.description: Owner (root account) public username, if set. Useful for shared views.
ownerUsername.title: owner_username

removed.description:
True when the caller no longer has access to this sub-account, for
 example after its owner removed the caller as a member: remove the
 sub-account from the caller's list. Only real-time updates set it;
 responses list only sub-accounts the caller can access. A change of the
 caller's role or access does not change revision or updated_at, so
 real-time updates deliver such changes in order and each one applies as
 it arrives. Ending access also ends the caller's subscriptions to this
 sub-account's real-time channels, and can, rarely, also end a
 subscription made after access was granted again. When the server ends a
 subscription to one of this sub-account's channels while the latest
 update lists this sub-account with a role and removed false, subscribe
 again: access is checked again on subscribe.
removed.title: removed

requireMemberMfa.description:
Owner-controlled security baseline for delegated interactive members on

 subscriptions.
requireMemberMfa.title: require_member_mfa

smartAccountAddress.description: Smart Account EVM address backing this sub-account.
smartAccountAddress.title: smart_account_address

smartAccountSaltNonce.description:
Smart-account derivation salt nonce assigned when this sub-account was

smartAccountSaltNonce.title: smart_account_salt_nonce

status.description: Current public lifecycle status of the sub-account.
status.title: status

subaccountPolicyId.title: subaccount_policy_id

updatedAt.description:
Time in UTC when this sub-account's configuration was last changed. For the

 earlier is stale. Equal timestamps with different configuration, other
 than role and removed, indicate an invariant failure.
updatedAt.title: updated_at
